rows.text: its board approves a **preferential issue of up to 10,78,974 equity shares at Rs 4,875, aggregating Rs 525,99,98,250**, to SBI Mutual Fund (Rs 400.99 crore), SBI Emergent India Fund and Derive Trading and Resorts (Rs 49.99 crore each) and Asha Mukul Agrawal (Rs 24.99 crore), subject to shareholders at an EGM on 4 October.
